label: Sci-fi colony
blurb: A space station or frontier colony: engineers, medics, pilots and drifters.
hobbies: keeping a logbook of every ship that docks
trading recipes from a dozen worlds
listening to Earth broadcasts on a delay
quirks: talking to the station AI like an old friend
never taking off {poss} lucky mission patch
keeping a tiny plant on every desk
tapping the hull twice for luck before a shift
keeping a countdown to the next supply ship
never trusting an elevator that hesitates
reciting the safety checklist under {poss} breath
collecting mission patches from ships that never came back
always floating instead of walking when no one's looking
goals: being the first to walk a new moon
retiring to a real planet with real weather
building a home with an actual window
proving the old distress signal was real
peeves: people who float where they should walk
accessories: a neural port behind the ear
a breathing mask hanging at the neck
faintly glowing tattoos on the neck
a data-slate on a wrist strap
a small oxygen canister clipped to the belt
a mission patch on the sleeve
a pair of zero-g grip gloves tucked in a pocket
a battered dog tag on a chain
default_outfits: a plain colony-issue jumpsuit and worn boots
a padded work jacket over a gray jumpsuit and sturdy boots
a comfortable knit top, utility trousers and slip-on shoes
_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): augment-friendly glasses and marks, and a wider dye chance for neon colony fashion.

glasses.label: smart-tinted goggles pushed up on the forehead
a single optical implant lens over one eye

distinguishing.label: a small mole on the cheek
a small scar through one eyebrow
a glowing circuit-line tattoo along the jaw
a fine scar from a decompression accident
a subdermal LED implant that pulses faintly at the temple
a barcode-style ID tattoo on the forearm
a cybernetic jaw plate on one side
